\[

\]

Modulo \(a\), such an edge joins the residue class of \(x\) to the residue class of \(x+b\). Write

Because \(\gcd(p,q)=1\), we have \(\gcd(r,a)=1\).

\[

  r,\;2r,\;3r,\;\dots,\;(a-1)r,\;0 \pmod a

\[

\frac{(n+1)^2}{2}\cdot\frac{6}{\pi^2}

\[
